public.title: Basic Calculator II
public.description: Evaluate a valid nonempty expression of nonnegative decimal integers, spaces, and binary + - * / operators. Multiplication and division have higher precedence; equal-precedence operators associate left to right. Division truncates toward zero. There are no parentheses or unary operators; divisors are nonzero. Length is at most 500 and all intermediate integers have magnitude at most 1000000000.
hints: Keep signed additive terms on a stack.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Resolve multiplication and division against the current term immediately, then sum additive terms. O(n) time and space.
